title: Glittery Sleeveless  Pleated Empire Waist A-Line Formal Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Dazzle in our Glittery Sleeveless Pleated Empire Waist A-Line Formal Evening Dress. The shimmering fabric catches the light, while the pleated empire waist enhances the A-line silhouette for a flattering fit. This sleeveless dress exudes sophistication and glamour, making it an ideal choice for formal evenings. Elevate your style with a touch of sparkle and timeless elegance.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor Length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises polyester.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
